source: A useful surprise is that ZXNAME0000XZ is smaller than this ZXNAME0001XZ parameterization in raw cache capacity. ZXNAME0002XZ’s purpose is not “always produce the smallest cache.” It aims for a richer learned attention mechanism while still compressing the cache aggressively.
zh: 一个有用的惊喜是，ZXNAME0000XZ 的原始缓存容量小于 ZXNAME0001XZ 参数化。 ZXNAME0002XZ 的目的不是“总是产生最小的缓存”。它的目标是提供更丰富的学习注意力机制，同时仍然积极压缩缓存。
